name: Product pitch: steps, lists, numbers (test script)

lines.text: Let me show you how it works. First you talk, then Bill listens, and then the slide appears.
Here is what you get. No clicker, no slides to build, no stage fright, and pure improv.
We built it on four things. Voice, photos, GIFs, and charts.
Eighty percent of our beta testers never opened a slide editor again.
Now let's talk about the money.
A full hour of talking costs us eleven dollars.
Our biggest competitor charges twenty dollars a month for a template.
That is a joke, and we are the punchline.
To get started, you need three steps. Sign up, connect your mic, and say hello.
In the future we want to cover every stage in Europe.
Thank you all, see you in the Discord.
